title: Remove Spring scheduled method parameters
why: Spring scheduled methods must not declare parameters; a parameterized scheduled method can prevent scheduled task registration.
suggestion: Use a no-argument scheduled entry point and obtain collaborators or inputs through the managed object.
limitations: High-confidence findings bind canonical Scheduled through explicit imports, wildcard imports, or fully qualified names and require a parameterized method in a scoped Spring module. Managed-class evidence is limited to top-level nonabstract classes with canonical stereotypes or an unambiguous Bean return type.
Only parameters are checked: reactive and other supported scheduled return types are not rejected merely for being non-void.
Custom composed annotations, runtime registration, dynamic build configuration, unresolved Maven properties or remote parents, and non-Java source are not resolved.
